name: Mogan Enerji Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi
summary: Mogan Enerji Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi engages in the renewable energy business in Turkey. It generates and sells energy through geothermal, hydroelectric, wind, and solar power plants. Mogan Enerji Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
